answer: In an agent economy, progressive work isolation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to prove sequential, non-transferable contributions over time. A new agent starts in isolation, building a graded history of original tasks that cannot be shared or bulk-created. Imagine an ember glowing within a dune of accumulated proofs, slowly nurturing a grove of trusted interactions that only mature identities can access, ensuring fake accounts fail to match the sustained originality of established ones.
